reviews.text: This is a really fun and cute game with lots of banter and cute cat puns... I really like the game modes but they tend to get very hard for me :) Soundtrack is also soooo good! Being in EA is still already really fun to play, can't wait to see what the devs come up with as it has so much potential!

First off, very interesting game thats for sure. it gives the nostalgia with the space ship games ages ago. The music has a really nice vibe and you do can get hooked at it real quickly. in terms of difficulty i would say the Water stage as well as the Vertical one gave one a headache to get through. Cant wait to see more development to this game and curious about the story.

Recommending the game with an asterics for now. It has bugs that can become frustrating, but it's also in early access so if that doesn't bother you then the recommendation stands. Right now with 6 out of 10 stages available a typcal run takes give or take 28 minutes. There is a bonus for no-hitting a stage and it can get quite addictive to perfect a stage. The music is very fitting and the weapon upgrades feel impactful. If you are struggling to beat the game on extreme (took me a few tries to get a perfect run without deaths), you can just wait for the metaprogression mentioned in the roadmap. The artstyle is cute and flows well into what you are being offered. If you want a casual SHUMP experience this is a good one!

GREAT FUN. the game's come so far in the amount of time i've been following it and playing it! the latest drop is super fun and challenging. the graphics are really cute and there's whimsical fun thing about all the things you can shoot lol. 10/10 would recommend!

This game is what it feels like to be a cat on catnip. Very fun and satisfying gameplay. Reminded me of arcade except this time I play as much I want without inserting a coin in 10 seconds. Music is fantastic. The cat is so damn cute.
Great Schump For A Couple Of Yer Bucks. 10/10
Astro is a cat I didn't know I needed.

If you're into old school 90s era shooters, this one might be right up your alley! It's like old school vibes with a modern twist, and the cool thing is it plays great with my Neo Geo arcade stick I have set up on my arcade! Easy enough for anyone to jump into and have fun. I've been mainly playing it on my arcade, but it runs great on the OG Rog Aly as well I've found.
Much respect MEOW, hoping for linux support at some point. on the internet nobody knows your really a cat
The cats outlived the humans and are fighting the AI machines. Oh gosh, I hope my cat didn’t hear me. What will become of me?
Astro Burn is a love letter to 90s shoot ’em ups, wrapped in a cute, cat-powered package.
Astro Burn delivers a unique blend of chaos and charm. The visuals are engaging and the gameplay is rewarding. I appreciate the nostalgia while enjoying a modern twist.
The core loop is deliciously addictive. Dashing through bullets, chaining power-ups, and blasting through wave after wave of outrageous enemies feels incredibly satisfying.
Astro Burn hits every sweet spot. Solid progression, catchy soundtrack and a surprisingly deep scoring system make each run feel like a perfect victory.
Play as Astro, space cat with her robot companion! Dodge everything! Destroy anything! Stack ridiculous firepower & unleash anime style Catnip powered chaos in this fast paced cute-em-up bullet hell!
